name: threejs-polygon-streaming
description: Integrating Viverse Polygon Streaming (.xrg) into a Three.js scene via the @polygon-streaming/web-player-threejs NPM package.
prerequisites: Three.js scene with camera, renderer, and a per-frame update loop
KTX2 basis transcoder available at /lib/basis_transcoder.js and .wasm
Service worker served at web root
